ModMetaData.name: RimUtinni: The Unfinished Line
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
Nobody on this planet mass-produces droids. The Geonosian Foundry Hive knows how, and the factory patterns sit latent in their databases, but they are left-behind workers from a factory site, not a whole people, and they cannot run the line. The Free Droid Enclaves need it badly: they are escaped droids who can only repair each other, and every one they lose is lost for good. The Jawa are the only ones who can stand between them.
A five-beat quest chain (design/Jawa/proposals/droid_mass_production_quest_chain_2026-10-02.md). The chain is offered once the Free Droid Enclaves like you (goodwill 20), you can repair droids at a shop, and day 30 has passed. Each beat follows the last after a few days; a failed beat is offered again, and too many failures break the chain.
Built: the chain itself and all five beats. 1, "The Count": three badly damaged Enclave droids brought to your shop (your own good parts or worn ones; the Enclaves judge the job by the worst droid that walks out). 2, "The Envoy": two Hive overseers and their Enclave escort stay four days; accepting starts a truce the Enclaves broker, and harming a guest ends the truce and the chain. 3, "The Pattern Cores": recover three cores from the old silicax foundry ruin, past its wild droids, and refuse (or accept) an Imperial broker's offer for them. 4, "The Tithe and the Hands": load an Enclave shuttle with a large material tithe and one skilled crafter, lent to the line for ten days. 5, "First Light": hold your colony against an Imperial strike through the line's first run. Where the line stands (the site choice) is not built yet, so the later beats happen at your colony.
Mod Settings ("The Unfinished Line"): chain on/off, the goodwill and day gates, days between beats, failures allowed per beat, the brokered truce on/off, and per-beat tuning (the ruin, the broker, the tithe scale and the crafter asked for, the first run). Dev mode: Debug actions, Quests, "Offer The Unfinished Line (skip gates)" and "offer next beat now".
